newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Red Cross send 35 food lorries to Kabul.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross send 35 food lorries to Kabul.

text.p: The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) said on Sunday it had arranged a convoy of food and medical supplies in Pakistan to be sent to the Afghan capital Kabul, seized by the Taleban militia on Friday.
The convoy of 35 lorries was ready and likely to leave for Kabul on Monday from the northwestern Pakistani town of Peshawar, an ICRC official there told Reuters by telephone.
Local newspapers on Sunday quoted ICRC head in Islamabad Oliver Durron Sunday as saying his mission was waiting for a green signal from its Kabul office about the safety of the highway to Kabul.

There have been reports that the retreating forces of ousted President Burhanddin Rabbani had laid landmines near Sarobi town, east of Kabul, on the highway from the main eastern Afghan town of Jalalabad.
There was no independant confirmation of the report.
